title: 穿门后借关门截弹
observation_and_decision: 观察射手和会自行关合的实门，开门同时暴露射手视线；通过后停入门后落点，闭门必须在真实敌弹抵达前恢复遮挡。
causal_relationship: 真实bell_open、完整身体穿门、gate关闭及敌弹运动/消失；无伤目标稳定；不把仅等待动作当必要。

resources.air_shots: original single air charge; ground/hit recovery only

terrain: 低顶水平通道限制跳避，入口射手在背后，门后短终点没有其它弹道遮挡。
reward: visible original SimpleRoomReward chest at stable exit; actual transaction required
failure_cost: player damage/unstable landing rejects; no HP reset during case
distinction_from_existing: not an air-refund rise, recoil slot, carrier chase, timed same-shot gate crossing, brake pocket or high/low fork

implementation.release_requirement: exact clean, 6 mild screen, >=18 same-geometry counters, regular calibration and independent holdout; unsupported mechanism reported
